text:
Priya (Finance): LusoCloud (PT) billed our EU account with Portuguese VAT on SaaS invoice LC-2026-09 (VAT 23%). We have an Irish VAT on file. Can someone confirm treatment?
Joao (LusoCloud AP): Invoice uploaded: LC-2026-09.pdf (net EUR 4,000; VAT EUR 920). Vendor VAT ID = PT987654321. We billed VAT because our system saw a PT billing address.
Marco (AP): Payment is scheduled tomorrow; flagging to hold. Our customer VAT on file = IE9876543V (Redwood Inference EU).
Ilya (Tax): If this is a B2B supply of services within the EU, place of supply is where the customer is established (Ireland) so reverse charge should apply and vendor should not charge PT VAT. We need a corrected invoice plus credit note. Also vendor should quote both VAT IDs and add "reverse charge - art. 196" or local equivalent.
Priya (Finance): Agreed. Vendor also needs evidence of our VAT ID at billing time to avoid VAT being charged. Please ask for: (1) credit note cancelling VAT; (2) replacement invoice net EUR 4,000 VAT 0% citing reverse charge and both VAT IDs; (3) short statement that VAT was charged in error and they will not remit the VAT to Portuguese tax authorities. Use the suggested note below.
Joao (LusoCloud AP): I'll send that. Also asked whether we require a signed certificate or is our VAT ID in vendor portal enough?
Ilya (Tax): Vendor portal copy of our VAT ID is acceptable as long as they keep records showing the buyer VAT ID and invoice references. No additional signed certificate is normally required for B2B EU services.
Priya (Finance): Suggested message to vendor (paste):
"Hi Joao,
Thanks for the invoice. Redwood Inference is VAT-registered in Ireland (IE9876543V). This supply is B2B and reverse charge applies. Please: (1) issue a credit note cancelling VAT EUR 920 on LC-2026-09; (2) issue a replacement invoice for net EUR 4,000, VAT 0% and a note: 'Reverse charge applies - Article 196 VAT Directive'; (3) include both VAT IDs (seller PT987654321, buyer IE9876543V) and reference original invoice number/date; (4) confirm you will not remit the VAT to Portuguese tax authorities for this supply.

Once we receive the credit note + corrected invoice we'll release payment.
Thanks,
Priya, Redwood Finance"
Joao (LusoCloud AP): Vendor replied: "Apologies, will issue CN + RC invoice by EOD and confirm portal record update."
Marco (AP): Holding payment. Please upload corrected docs to vendor file when received.
EngBillingBot: Ticket TAX-562 created to add a validation step: if buyer EU VAT on file then block automatic domestic VAT on vendor invoices; assignee = Marco; due = 2026-06-10.
Ilya (Tax): I'll log documents for VAT audit trail when uploaded. Keep copies of original invoice, credit note, and replacement invoice.
Priya (Finance): Received CN and replacement: uploaded LC-2026-09-CN.pdf and LC-2026-09-RC.pdf. I'll mark vendor as EU-B2B-REVERSE_CHARGE and release payment tomorrow.
Marco (AP): Payment scheduled on corrected invoice tomorrow. Closing after payment posts.
Priya (Finance): Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
